meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把时间轴、轨道与播放规则写成一份可稳定渲染的动画项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把动画视频的时间线、轨道和播放规则写成能稳定渲染的结构化项目。
copy.tagline_en: Turn timelines, tracks, and playback rules into a renderable animation project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want animation timelines and playback rules in a structured, renderable form.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 HyperFrames 合成契约写 HTML:用 data-* 属性声明时间,标记 class="clip" 片段、轨道、子合成与变量,再用 lint、check 校验。
howto.when: 当你要写或改一个可渲染的 HyperFrames 合成 HTML,或需要合成结构、data-* 计时属性、子合成等规则时触发。原文要求写合成 HTML 前先读它。

say.text: 从最小骨架开始写一个能渲染的 HyperFrames 合成
say.note: 它会按合成契约给出骨架 HTML

say.text: 帮我加一个子合成,并用变量把数据传进去

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes HyperFrames composition HTML: timing declared with data-* attributes, class="clip" elements, tracks, sub-compositions and variables, then validated with lint and check.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you build or edit a renderable HyperFrames composition HTML, or need rules for composition structure, data-* timing, sub-compositions, etc. Read before writing composition HTML.
